verdict.rationale: Bolna is a voice-agent platform, so model-based end-of-turn detection is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions turn detection, endpointing, VAD configuration or interruption handling. The closest items cover STT providers, speech-to-speech models and mid-call language switching, which are different capabilities.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
